programme.title: Vices
programme.desc: Simone, a married woman battling anxiety and the lingering shadow of her past alcoholism, escapes to collect her thoughts. When a storm isolates her in her remote cabin, she's hunted by two forces: the seductive pull of her past addiction, and a cunning serial killer. Surrounded by a web of lies and sin, Simone must face her inner demons before a literal one ends her life.

programme.title: Somebody's Got to Die
programme.desc: After leading a life of contract killing, Jake makes a promise to his fiancé, Nicole, to go on the straight and narrow. He finds solace in running a bar with his brother Kelvin. When his former Kingpin Marcel offers him a way out, he is forced to confront shadows of his past, and overcome one of the biggest jobs of his criminal career.

programme.title: Repay it in Blood
programme.desc: Ten years after a robbery left their sister dead and their father broken, prosecutor Larissa and her sister Maritza, a top trauma nurse, are done waiting for justice. But just as the sisters begin targeting the crew responsible for that bloody night, the truth becomes deadlier than they anticipated.

programme.title: The New Girl
programme.desc: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica's seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister. She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister's life but her own.

programme.title: The Special Affect
programme.desc: Expecting mother & artist, Destiny, spirals after a tragic loss. Her loving husband helps her cope, but a bad trip and missed meds spark disturbing memories. With the help of her best friend, Destiny uncovers a horrifying truth about her past.

programme.title: The Wait Game
programme.desc: Yolanda Hills, a woman deeply in love with her longtime partner Jonas Jones, has been patiently awaiting their wedding day. Their idyllic relationship takes a terrifying turn when a home intruder invades their peaceful sanctuary. Held captive in her own home, Yolanda is confronted with a shocking revelation that will forever alter the course of their lives.

programme.desc: After a harrowing event that nearly kills Claudia, she and her husband try their best to move on. Claudia and Marcus then hire a new mid-wife to assist as they prepare for their new child. But they don't know that Erica is lurking in the shadows, and she wants that baby.

programme.title: Deadly Housewife
programme.desc: Florence is a housewife who yearns for something new and exciting in her love life. Things turn deadly real quick when she doesn't get what she wants.

programme.title: The Saved and the Salacious
programme.desc: Ashton, Isaac, and Terrell have dreams of making it big in the gospel music industry, and making an impact in the world; however, worlds collide when they meet the nefarious founder and owner of Titan Records, Rodney "Rod" Wallace.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: Karmen, a successful businesswoman is secure and thriving in every part of her life, except for love. She downloads a dating app and seems to have found Mr. Right in Jermaine, but her best friends warn her that he might be a scammer. As Karmen falls deeper, she slowly falls victim to a network of lies and deceit, that could cost her life.

programme.desc: Held hostage in a diner, ten very different people, learn they have more in common than it appears.

programme.title: Blood 4 Blood

programme.title: Anchors Away
programme.desc: Rick Dale, one of Pawn Stars' most popular experts, runs Las Vegas based Rick's Restorations, a family business that finds, restores and upcycles cool objects ranging from Cadillacs to Coke Machines. The before and after reveals of his work are always highlights, in part because of the history nuggets Rick Dale shares about each object, whether it's a barber chair or a gas pump. In this spinoff series, featuring the dynamic characters at Rick's workplace, viewers will watch a variety of objects be bought, bartered and transformed, learning the process of restoration -- how do you duplicate Coke machine red? Where can you find 1920's tires? A storyteller who works with tools instead of a pen, Rick shares when and why objects were invented, who used them and how fixing or transforming them changes their value.

programme.desc: R. programme.title: Short Sword Damascus
programme.desc: In each episode, the best bladesmiths from all over the country come to the forge for a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, to square off against our renowned Forged in Fire Masters in the highest stakes forging competition yet! programme.desc: Roadways can be a wild place. With violent road rage incidents increasing 500% over the last decade, 'road raging' is a human behavior that has become widely known. The bad driving phenomenon hasn't helped either-- in fact it's said that 80% of all accidents are caused by 20% of drivers. "Road Wars" takes a deep dive into American roadways, examining extreme human behavior, wild weather, insane accidents and a few welcomed instances of acts of kindness.

programme.title: Country Chaos
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: Road to Intimacy
programme.desc: Seven years marks a defining point in many relationships when couples find themselves restless, dissatisfied, and_x000D_ curious about what life would be like with someone else. Seven Year Switch? lets them find out. For two whole weeks, couples swap partners to see what life is like living with a complete stranger who seems to have all the qualities these individuals think they are missing in their current relationships. Will this ultimate experiment in "switch therapy" provide new appreciation for the love they have or entice them to call it quits?

programme.title: The Weddings are Coming! The Weddings Are Coming!
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: Penny's Little Party
programme.desc: This series is a spin-off following Terra and Joe from Little Women: LA as they embark on this new journey as little parents. We'll catch up with them during the final prep for their impending baby's arrival and cover their hospital birth, dealing with the many firsts of parenthood as they bring home their bundle of joy. Watch as this little couple navigates ordinary parenting challenges that averaged sized people might take for granted in extraordinary ways. The series culminates with the revelation of the baby's genetic makeup. Do they have a dwarf baby or an average sized baby?

programme.title: Penny's Little Party
programme.desc: This series is a spin-off following Terra and Joe from Little Women: LA as they embark on this new journey as little parents. We'll catch up with them during the final prep for their impending baby's arrival and cover their hospital birth, dealing with the many firsts of parenthood as they bring home their bundle of joy. Watch as this little couple navigates ordinary parenting challenges that averaged sized people might take for granted in extraordinary ways. The series culminates with the revelation of the baby's genetic makeup. Do they have a dwarf baby or an average sized baby?

programme.title: Up Syndrome
programme.desc: Two-time Emmy? award winner for Outstanding Casting and Outstanding Cinematography Reality Program (2017) and Outstanding Unstructured Reality Series (2016). Born This Way, follows a group of seven young adults born with Down syndrome along with their family and friends in Southern California. The inspiring docuseries provides an intimate look at a diverse group of young men and women as they pursue their passions and lifelong dreams, explore friendships, romantic relationships and work, all while defying society?s expectations. The series also gives voice to the parents, allowing them to talk about the joy their son or daughter brings to their family, and the challenges they face in helping them live as independently as possible._x000D_

programme.title: Danny Bible/License To Kill
programme.desc: The series examines each piece of forensic evidence, each witness, each possible lead, and each turn in the road that ultimately leads detectives to their killer. Cold Case Files is a pioneer in the nonfiction forensics genre.

programme.title: Devil In Disguise
programme.desc: However shocking the crime, media headlines eventually fade, but for heartbroken friends and family, the memories and their longing for justice never do. Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: Although she has an excellent job at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and a fabulous apartment with model roommates, New Yorker Amanda Pierce remains unlucky in love and intent on finding the right guy. When she develops a crush on neighbor Jim Winston, she begins to spy on him and witnesses his apparent involvement in a murder. Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Moon Over Parador
programme.desc: When the iron-fisted ruler of a small African nation dies, his top aide, Roberto Strausmann (Raul Julia), will do anything to avoid a regime change, so he recruits struggling film actor Jack Noah (Richard Dreyfuss) to pose as the deceased political leader. Jack looks just like the man he's portraying, and, with Strausmann's expert instruction, he successfully fools the world. But as Jack falls for ravishing humanitarian Madonna Mendez (Sônia Braga), he decides to use his influence for good.

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs

When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Drag Me to Hell
programme.desc: Christine Brown has a loving boyfriend and a good job at a Los Angeles bank. Her heavenly life becomes hellish when, in an effort to impress her boss, she denies an old woman's request for an extension on her home loan. In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. Christine seeks a psychic's help to break the curse, but the price to save her soul may be more than she can pay.

There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. programme.title: Problem Child
programme.desc: Ben is a good-hearted guy who's always wanted a son of his own, but so far he and his wife have had no success. The couple adopt Junior, a redheaded hellion who quickly makes their lives miserable. Disaster follows Junior wherever he goes, from camping trips that require emergency-room visits to birthday parties that turn into Grand Guignol affairs. When Ben's incensed family tells him to get rid of the boy, he starts to wonder if they might be right.

programme.title: Problem Child 2
programme.desc: Ben Healy (John Ritter) and his adopted son, the mischievous and destructive Junior (Michael Oliver), move to a new town for a fresh start in what happens to be "the divorcée capital of the world." Now the two face a multitude of women throwing themselves at Ben, though a new mom isn't what Junior wants. But Junior has more to worry about than his father's dates -- the little troublemaker might have met his match in Trixie Young (Ivyann Schwan), a small girl with a big chip on her shoulder.

programme.title: American Pie Presents: Band Camp
programme.desc: Eager to carry on his older brother's legacy of mischievous and lewd behavior, Matt Stifler (Tad Hilgenbrinck) masterminds a school prank that lands him in serious trouble. Banished to band camp as punishment, Matt initially rails against his geeky and musically inclined surroundings, but he has a change of heart when he encounters the lovely Elyse (Arielle Kebbel), his childhood love interest. Can Matt tame his raucous inclinations to win the girl of his dreams?

programme.title: American Wedding
programme.desc: Even though Jim (Jason Biggs) and Michelle (Alyson Hannigan) have been dating for several years, she's still surprised when he proposes to her in their favorite restaurant. programme.title: American Reunion
programme.desc: In the summer of 1999, four small-town Michigan boys began a quest to lose their virginity. In the ensuing years, Jim (Jason Biggs) has married Michelle (Alyson Hannigan), though Kevin (Thomas Ian Nicholas) has left Vicky (Tara Reid). Oz (Chris Klein) has grown apart from Heather (Mena Suvari), but Finch still has the hots for Stifler's (Seann William Scott) mom (Jennifer Coolidge). These lifelong friends have come home to reminisce about — and become inspired by — their former teen selves.

programme.title: Admission
programme.desc: When straight-laced Princeton University admissions officer Portia Nathan (Tina Fey) pays a recruiting visit to an alternative high school, she receives some news that catches her way off-guard. John Pressman (Paul Rudd), head of the school and Portia's former college classmate, has surmised that his student, Jeremiah, is the son that Portia secretly gave up for adoption. Portia puts her career at risk by bending the rules for Jeremiah but also discovers a life and romance she never imagined.

programme.title: Evan Almighty
programme.desc: Newscaster Evan Baxter (Steve Carell) leaves Buffalo behind when he wins a seat in Congress. Moving his wife (Lauren Graham) and family to northern Virginia, he seems to have it made, then God (Morgan Freeman) throws a crisis of biblical proportions at his feet: The Lord wants him to build an ark and line up all the animals two-by-two in preparation for a flood.

programme.title: Balls of Fury
programme.desc: A hard fall from grace strips Randy Daytona of being considered a ping pong phenomenon. Now he must bounce back to take on an undercover assignment for the government. The FBI wants him to enter a tournament sponsored by Feng, a ping-pong enthusiast and notorious criminal. Randy must get the goods on Feng and bring him to justice.

programme.title: The Search for JonBenét's Killer

programme.title: Murder on the Dark Web

programme.title: The Fitbit Alibi

programme.desc: Somto is found battered inside his crashed car. After his burial in Lagos he is found alive and married in another city Enugu. Could it be that his ghost is existing and living another life or could his death and burial have been all planned?.

programme.title: Purgare
programme.desc: A man must discover the truth about himself to determine his fate.

programme.title: Yawa
programme.desc: Toba and Gboyega brings home a girl for a "one night stand", what is supposed to be a few minutes of pleasure soon lands them into trouble when the girl dies. They must do everything possible to dispose the dead body before day break, they get into a bigger problem when a third party walks in on them.

programme.title: Dau
programme.desc: We follow a story of a female tour guide who wants to rescue her human trafficked 16 year old sister.

programme.title: Scama O'Rama
programme.desc: Two friends, Charles and Nebu battle with survival in the city of Lagos, Nigeria and after searching and struggling to secure any meaningful paying jobs decide to create a fake insurance scheme to defraud unsuspecting victims. Their plan works until a friend reveals their plot to the authorities.

programme.title: First Born
programme.desc: A grade six boy Langcer Divine (Frubi Rollins) is caught in a web of abuse and neglect by his school teachers and peers because of his dullness. He is refused to be registered as an internal candidate for the Common Entrance Examination, as the school wishes to uphold its reputation of academic excellence. Back at home, Divine being the lone child to his parents, goes through emotional torture as they scold at him at every given opportunity. In the midst of his pain and dark clouds, his class teacher Mr. Pangala Nicodemus (Tampy Livinus) comes to his rescue by unraveling a biblical revelation 'Exodus 13:2'. It is discovered that Divine as a first born to his parents, inherited a curse. Could this have been the cause of his dullness or was he a victim of stigmatization and hate by a school system that cares for bright pupils and its reputation to the detriment of slow learners?

programme.title: Best Of
programme.desc: Best Of is a vibrant, fast-paced lifestyle TV show that takes viewers on a captivating journey through diverse industries. Each episode features in-depth interviews with top professionals and innovators in their respective fields.

programme.title: Best Of
programme.desc: Best Of is a vibrant, fast-paced lifestyle TV show that takes viewers on a captivating journey through diverse industries. Each episode features in-depth interviews with top professionals and innovators in their respective fields.

programme.title: Tom, Dick & Harrie Episode 1
programme.desc: "Tom, Dick, and Harrie" is a hilarious web series that unfolds the comedic tale of two roommates - Tom and Dick - facing the financial strain of rent. To alleviate their burden, they decide to find a third roommate through a social media ad. Enter Harrie, a mysterious new tenant who happens to be Dick's ex-girlfriend, Harriet. Harriet seizes the opportunity to re-enter Dick's life in an unconventional way; disguising herself as a guy named Harrie and secretly paying for a room in their apartment. When Dick discovers the ruse, he proposes a temporary truce, agreeing to cohabitate for a month until Harrie can find alternative accommodation. What ensues is a rollercoaster of comedic episodes as the once lovebirds navigate the challenges of living together again. Will the close quarters and shared experiences rekindle their old flame, or will it lead to more chaos and hilarity? Join Tom, Dick, and the disguised Harrie as they embark on a month-long journey that unravels into unexpected twists and turns. Discover whether this unusual living arrangement sparks a new chapter in their relationships and buckle up for a laughter-filled ride in "Tom, Dick, and Harrie."

programme.title: Live Connections: Runtown
programme.desc: "Get ready for a captivating experience with 'Soundgod' Afrobeats Artist Runtown and his band. In this one-hour special, follow Runtown, his talented dancers, and the dedicated film crew as they prepare for a spectacular live event in London.

programme.title: The Coffin Salesman
programme.desc: Uwem is a small town business man who has hit hard times as he has not made sales because he lives in a town where everyone is exercising, quitting smoking and generally trying to live healthier lifestyles. This isn’t good for his business as sales are seriously reduced. His problems are compounded when his wife leaves him and he is left with their daughter Nse who is suspended from school for refusing to take off her superhero costume. Uwem has to also contend with the aggressive takeover of his new neighbor HD Yaw who owns KPAI Assassination Limited and covets his small business. Everything comes to a head when he meets Ogun Lesley who is dying and has a list of odd things he wants to do before he goes…and this becomes Uwem’s most important coffin sale

programme.title: Daughters of Donald
programme.desc: Chief Donald is living the later years of his life in lonesome luxury and perfect celibacy. But the peace and quiet in his big mansion are shattered when one young lady, and then another, suddenly show up claiming to be his daughters from past relationships he had completely forgotten about. And it will not stop there: everyone is now a suspect as ghosts from Chief Donald’s adventurous past come to haunt him in the form of children, he never knew he had, including some who have been living and working right under his nose, unbeknownst to him. The cultural conflicts and heartbreaking drama resulting from this late discovery of self, and the trauma imposed by DNA tests and struggles for belonging, are only subdued by the hilarious natures of the comic characters who bring the whole story to life. The movie is set in Asaba (Nollywood), Nigeria, featuring actors from Cameroon and Nigeria. Generous use of African Music provided by BGC Melody from Cameroon, Congo DRC, Ghana and Nigeria. Executive Production by Don Julio Bats for BGC Melody Story

programme.title: Wayunagu
programme.desc: A former Kickboxer from the United States named Ivan, returns to his native land of Honduras. Viewed as a foreigner by the locals, Ivan has a hard time fitting in. After a botched robbery and accidental murder of a teenager, Ivan finds himself being hunted by a group of machete wielding bandits intent on revenge. Lost, injured and alone, Ivan must discover himself in the jungles of Honduras and face his fears, in order to save his own life...

programme.title: Obambo
programme.desc: Present day March 15 2021, it is night Zabron arrives at the haunted house that is believed to have Obambo ghost. Short while Tama arrives as well. Zabron draw a knife ready to fight the ghost Obambo but Tama stops him. Tama tells Zabron that he must know the history first before fighting Obambo because it is believed that is the most powerful ghost than any ghost that Zabron has fought before. 2003, it is night, Zunda and his family; his wife Mona, younger sister Anna and younger brother Leonard are getting things in the house that is believed to have Obambo ghost. Zunda tells Leonard to hurry up because he has a lot to do tomorrow at his work. The family members are at dinner table eating. Suddenly Obambo hand take Leonard food. Leonard panics and drop the spoon. Other members look at him surprisingly. Leonard get the spoon under the table and sees Obambo’s feet. Leonard panics again and asks everyone if they have seen it to which everyone is surprised. Zunda tells Leonard to go to his room and take his foolishness there. Leonard tells his brother that they are not alone in the house and leaves. Anna laughs at Leonard. On the way to the his room, Leonard heard unsettling noises and see red flashes and smoke coming from one of the room. He stops turn around and investigate the matter before a door open in the other direction. Leonard turns and he can see a person resembles his brother stand beside the door. Leonard calls him but no answer. His brother Zunda comes and asks him who is talking to and Leonard says that he saw his brother standing on the door. Zunda tells Leonard not to stand near the room where noises are heard as the house owner asks Zunda not to open that room. Zunda gets angry and tell him to go to his room and sleep. His wife Mona and asks him why they should not open the room, Zunda replies that the house owner asked him to do that as there are his belongings there. It is mid night. Anna gets to bed. Obambo is seen in the shadow getting near her bed and put something on the flowers. Her bedsheet is pulled off. She gets up worried and take the bedsheet and cover her up. After few seconds the bedsheet is pulled again and she wakes and sit on the bed. Anna starts to look up and sees Obambo in the ceiling. She screams. The family members hears the scream and get in Anna’s room quickly. She is terrified.

programme.title: The Thorns
programme.desc: In the romantic dramedy, The Thorns, Lateef Adedimeji as Pelumi, resolves never to love again because of the crisis he encountered with love on different occasions, until he meets the hilarious fake Prophet Egbojuayosoke, Woli Agba Ayo Ajewole, who prophesies that love is about to smile on him again.

programme.title: Wamaitha
programme.desc: This is a love story film set in the colonial era during the height of the Mau Mau rebellion, the story seeks to highlight the role played by women in the Mau Mau arms struggle for independence.

programme.title: Genesis of the Ashantis
programme.desc: Once Upon A Time, The Great Ashanti Tribe and Guans in Ghana, Africa went to war because of the Golden Horn. Whoever gets the Golden Horn will be Supreme among all the Tribes, but the Prophecy has it that only the Chosen One can hold the Golden Horn...between the Prince of the Ashantis and the Guans who is the Chosen One and who will win this battle?

programme.title: The Cursed Treasure
programme.desc: Danso returns home from Agege with two friends of his where their expectations were not met. Back home, Danso and his friends engage in all forms of acts to survive. Danso however chances on vital information that changes his life and sets the viewers of the movie THE CURSED TREASURE (Made In Agege) on a roller-coaster.

programme.title: Her Broken Shadow
programme.desc: Two anthropophobic women are struggling to write novels. Adongo lives in East Africa in the near future while Apio lives in a space city in the distant future. They look so alike that one has to be the other’s doppelganger. Both are hermits, estranged from their respective families, and are suffering from loneliness. When the boundary between their worlds collapses, they discover that each is the protagonist in the novel the other is writing. Each believes she is real and the other a fabrication, yet their histories indicate that they might be identical twins, and that one murdered the other. As they struggle to understand the nature of their existence, they fail to tell reality from fantasy, the past from the present, and they have to solve the murder each committed in her childhood to avoid a complete descent into madness.

programme.title: Jomako Black Democracy
programme.desc: An artist mobilizes the local people to support him in his voice campaign to restore true democracy but gets a prison sentence for his act.

programme.title: Kiapo
programme.desc: Maimuna a beautiful young woman who meets Suleimani through her friend Mariam. Suleiman is a young man who sells coconut milk in Mombasa beach. Maimuna is undergoing a rough patch in life as her father Yusufu has been retrenched and the family’s income is dwindling. Despite the fact that Suleimani has been born in a poor family he is focused and determined to succeed in life, he is intending to start his own coconut wine making company using his own formula. The love between Maimuna and Suleimani keeps on growing day by day, Suleimani decides to go and meet Maimuna’s parents to inform them of their engagement. Upon reaching there he meets Yusufu and his sister Leila. Leila asks him what he does for living. Suleimani explains that he sells coconut milk. Yusufu gets angry and chases him away telling him to go and look for love in the beach among the other beach boys. Maimuna’s love to Suleimani continues to grow despite family’s disapproval of Suleimani. When Maimuna is admitted in Accounts College Suleimani works hard and pays for her fees. Maimuna promises Suleimani that she will not leave him till eternity. Upon Maimuna’s graduation from Accounts college, Leila forces her to go with her to Nairobi and work in her soap making company. Leila owns the soap making company in partnership with Sammy. Sofia, Maimuna’s mother is ill at this time which also pushes Maimuna to go and wok to help her family. Suleimani tries to talk to her not to go to Nairobi as he is making more money than what she will be paid by Leila. Maimuna is torn what to do but finally Leila wins and she is forced to go to Nairobi. Maimuna is afraid that once she leaves for Nairobi Suleimani will get another girl and forget about her. She confides her worries to Rehema her friend. Her friend tells her that there is a baobab tree under which any vow made will remain forever. When Maimuna tells Suleimani she wants them to go and make a vow under that Baobab tree Suleimani says that his love is unconditional with or without the oath. Upon Maimuna’s insistence he agrees and they make an oath under the Baobab tree that they will love each other till eternity. Maimuna travels to Nairobi and Suleimani keeps the love burning. Suleimani’s business expands and he starts saving for his wedding with Maimuna and capital for his company. Leila forces Maimuna to marry Sammy her business partner. When Maimuna

programme.desc: Jean Luc, journeys to Rwanda to find his absent father after his mother falls ill, armed only with a portrait and a location. Though he speaks Kinyarwanda, his search grows complicated when he falls for Olive.

programme.title: Being Bahati S2 Episode 4
programme.desc: Hitmaker Bahati and his singer wife, Diana, navigate infidelity rumors, parenthood and the weight of fame while living the high life in Nairobi.

programme.title: Being Bahati S2 Episode 5
programme.desc: Hitmaker Bahati and his singer wife, Diana, navigate infidelity rumors, parenthood and the weight of fame while living the high life in Nairobi.

programme.desc: Hitmaker Bahati and his singer wife, Diana, navigate infidelity rumors, parenthood and the weight of fame while living the high life in Nairobi.

programme.title: Jewel In The Sand
programme.desc: A teacher is sent by the government in the deep rural areas of Botswana to take education for all, but he is rejected by the native community and accused of a crime he never committed in order to chase him out of the village.

programme.title: Gacal
programme.desc: Lonely and heartbroken, Assad is left at home while his charming brother, Nuur, heads out on a long-awaited date with a woman he has been pursuing. Little does Assad know that this day will turn his life upside down. Just as Nuur steps out, a sudden knock on the door startles Assad. Opening it, he is met with a powerful punch to the face. Standing before him is Barkhad, the husband of the woman Nuur is currently on a date with. Barkhad, in a case of mistaken identity, believes Assad is his wife's illicit lover.Fueled by anger and a desire to seek revenge on Nuur, Barkhad decides to take matters into his own hands. He restrains Assad as he waits, knife in hand, for Nuur to return. As the day unfolds, a twist of fate intertwines the lives of Assad, Barkhad, and Nuur. Forced to spend time together, Assad and Barkhad gradually find common ground and an unexpected bond. Sharing their stories and vulnerabilities, they start to question their judgments and perceptions of one another.

programme.title: Jackie and the Genie
programme.desc: A young girl has a difficult life living on the outskirts of Kampala with problems at home and at school. A chance encounter with a Genie changes her life when he gives her magic powers.Although she agrees that these must only be used for good purposes she quickly forgets and uses them for her own benefits and entertainment ,changing as a person as time goes by. Giving up on her family and friends she learns the hard way what really is important in life.

programme.title: Man of Gold
programme.desc: After inheriting his father's church, Miracle and his friend Tobias venture into the gold delivery business, only to have the gold stolen. Desperate to repay the debt, they hatch a plan to use the church.

programme.title: Silver Lining
programme.desc: Young, professional, and successful, Zoe and Boyd, a medical doctor, desperately want to have a baby. She is in her third pregnancy, and the family is doing everything possible to see Zoe successfully deliver, but she has a third miscarriage, while being hesitant to tell the family. Lubanji, Zoe's old best friend who is fleeing for stealing money from her ruthless fiancé, seeks Boyd's assistance in delivering the baby she is carrying so that she can sell it to some old woman, but Zoe instead begs Boyd to buy the child from her when it is born while she pretends to be pregnant. Everything appears to be fine until Lubanji is abducted by her fiancé on the day of her delivery.

programme.title: The Set Up
programme.desc: A former drug smuggler and a confidence artist gets more than she bargains for when she is hired by a down on his luck businessman to assist with his scheme to marry a wealthy heiress. Things quickly take a turn for the worse as she realises that there is more to the scheme than meets the eye.

programme.title: Breaking with Customs
programme.desc: Tyranny chief with his guards storms Nono’s home for her daughter Nsanji whom the chief wants to be his fourth wife as tradition puts it. But Nsanji refuses because she loves Mpaka, her long-time fiancé. When the Chief leaves, Nono beats Nsanji badly until she accepts to marry the Chief. When the inflexible Mpaka gets to know about it, he launches war against the chief although his Father warns him not to defy tradition. Shortly, Mpaka helps Nsanji escape from the palace. Quickly, the Chief launches a deadly hunt for them, and soldiers search the whole village until they capture them one by one. While on a punishment podium, whipped Mpaka swears never to dump Nsanji and Nsanji does the same.

programme.title: Funny Universe
programme.desc: Ese has a striking resemblance to Mrs. Bucknor's lost daughter, Mrs. Bucknor's protege Festus employs Ese to pretend to be Mrs. Bucknor's long lost granddaughter so he can steal all of her wealth.

programme.title: Strawberry Chinny
programme.desc: After a brutal breakup leaves her homeless, a 28-year-old makeup artist moves in with her childhood best friend, but their platonic bond is tested when his demanding new girlfriend enters the picture, forcing them to confront their true feelings for each other.

programme.title: Deranged
programme.desc: Widower Dominic questions his daughter Julie about the man responsible for the baby she is carrying but she seems not to remember. Dominic disown Julie with a hard slap and chases her away from home. Unsure, Julie rushes to Allan whom he finds in a hideout playing cards with his gang friends. Allan blasts her straight away, denying to be the father of the baby which confuses Julie furthermore. Unsure again, Julie meets her last resort Wilbur (whom she had sex with a few months back), in a church corridor who also does the same as Allan. But something happens. Wilbur's Wife Emily catches them unaware and when she tries to kill Julie with a knife, Wilbur shields Julie who narrowly escapes. Jealously Emily pierces herself to death. Julie wonders off. Left with no option, she takes poison from an abandoned house where a Psychotic guy Tembo leaves. One hour later, Tembo comes back and finds Julie nearly dying. He rushes her to a nearby clinic, where doctors find out that she had aborted the baby. Later Tembo takes Julie with him to another abandoned warehouse. When Dominic's love for his daughter Julie resurfaces, he starts looking for her but it’s too late. When he later learns that Julie is completely missing, he employs officer Toby and Nita to find her. Tory and Nita brutally arrest Allan together with his new girlfriend and question them about Julies' whereabouts. Allan denies everything, which makes Toby keep both them in custody. Dominic announces on radio and TVs promising to give 800 dollars to whoever find Julie. He also makes a poster that circulate around with Julie's Photo, names, and age. Secretly, Julie hopelessly leaves with Tembo and Nine moths later she delivers a baby at death's door, whom they named "Tine".One day when Tembo goes to steal food for breastfeeding Julie, he is caught and beaten black and blue. He does not come back to Julie anymore, which makes Julie wander off with her baby Tine. She leaves Tine with Eric who once dated her when she was at Tembo's place and goes to her father. Happily, Dominic welcomes and forgives Julie. But shortly, mysteriously Tembo kidnap Julie from the borehole to his new scrappy shelter. He brutally demands Julie for his child Tine but Julie lies to him that Tine died. This is where Emily's Ghost comes in and in revenge, tells Tembo the truth that Julie is lying. Tembo cruelly whips Julie for this.

programme.title: Third Floor Pigu
programme.desc: When Ugandan businessman Dalima travels to Dar es Salaam to reunite with his lover Nana, their romantic escape takes a terrifying turn inside a city hotel where the third floor hides a deadly secret. After a malfunctioning elevator and a sudden blackout, an unseen presence begins hunting the floor’s occupants, turning hallways into traps and rooms into graves. As panic spreads and the city outside carries on unaware, Dalima must confront the force stalking them. Third Floor Pigu is a tense supernatural thriller where love, fear, and survival collide, proving that unimaginable horror can exist

programme.title: Taliya
programme.desc: In an idyllic fishing village off the coast of Kenya, Babu, a poor but ambitious fisherman, ensnares Taliya, a mermaid-like water spirit, in stolen nets. Unable to get his 'three wishes' (or is it five) as told in the village's stories of old, Babu decides to exploit Taliya as a grand magical theatrical exhibit instead. He employs the Village Storyteller to help sell his story to the masses but soon comes to conflict with the Chief's Son and a White Missionary Priest, who wish to end his act. He manages to co-opt the Chief's Son who sees Taliya as a Weapon to exploit. But Taliya herself just wants to go home and so must effect her own plan, using Babu's own mal-formed eight-year-old son as a crucial part of her exit strategy.

programme.title: Foods of Kenya Episode 6
programme.desc: Mwaniki Mageria travels across Kenya, immersing himself in diverse communities to uncover how traditional cuisine shapes cultural identity and daily life.

programme.title: Foods of Kenya Episode 7
programme.desc: Mwaniki Mageria travels across Kenya, immersing himself in diverse communities to uncover how traditional cuisine shapes cultural identity and daily life.

programme.title: Nairobi Law
programme.desc: Richard Mwako runs his law firm with an iron hand. He demands the best from his associates and never hesitates to make decisions that he believes are in his clients' best interests.

programme.title: Nairobi Law
programme.desc: Richard Mwako runs his law firm with an iron hand. He demands the best from his associates and never hesitates to make decisions that he believes are in his clients' best interests.

programme.title: Saint Music
programme.desc: Saint Music is a documentary exploring Ethiopian music, its brief history and the challenges it faces. The film comprises of interviews of the country's music elite including Mr. Yilma Gebre Ab, Mr. Dawit Yifu, Betty G. and others as well as a brief overview of the prominent music school; Yared Music School named after Yared who is considered to be the father of Ethiopian music.

programme.title: Something Necessary
programme.desc: Their worlds forever changed by politically instigated violence following the Kenyan election, Anne and Joseph's paths intersect. Can they shed the painful memories of the past to find redemption?

programme.title: Boda Love
programme.desc: A romantic comedy about a British woman who falls for an internet romance scam in Kenya and is rescued by a boda boda driver. Sparks fly when she moves into his humble home in Nairobi with his family.

programme.title: The Stand Up
programme.desc: The stand up is a story about a young man’s journey from Warri to becoming a top standup comedian in Lagos against the backdrop of the wild crime scene of both cities. Ovie (Paul Olope) is our lead, a Warri boy who works as a security guard with his father.

programme.title: Oluwoonko (Torn Apart)
programme.desc: In Uganda, the forbidden love between Owinenza, a Munyarwanda girl, and Kasule, a Muganda man, sparks conflict among rival communities when their relationship becomes public. As prejudice and violence rise, their courage challenges generations of division and becomes a powerful symbol of hope and unity.

After the death of his brother, a young boy struggles with accepting the inevitable loss. Torn between holding on and letting go, we journey back to a time before we were exposed to the outside world without having to open the front door.

programme.title: Nalwawo
programme.desc: A story set in an affluent suburb of Kampala where Nanta Sentamu is a beautiful middle-aged woman married to Kwezi Sentamu, a man Nanta’s family consider the ultimate catch and one who can do no wrong. Nanta has dedicated her life to being the perfect wife catering to her husband’s needs in every way despite the fact their 10 year marriage is childless, with the blame solely put on Nanta’s shoulders; after all it is always the woman’s fault if a couple is childless as has been traditionally opined. Despite having a degree, Nanta married Kwezi, a man 20 years her senior, straight out of University because he had taken on the financial responsibility of her education, an arrangement Kwezi made with her father when he saw the 15-year old Nanta come visit her father at the law-firm Kwezi owned. Despite the loneliness and isolation in her marriage, Nanta has constantly been told how lucky she is that she is married to a man that can provide for her and help her family. However, Kwezi, a high-profile lawyer who is rarely seen with his wife, dates frequently and is constantly linked with multiple women, but he refuses Nanta to work or have a life outside of their home. Nanta’s failed desperate attempts to win her husband’s love and affection, her inability to conceive a child and her numerous financial obligations to her family have taken a toll on her mentally and emotionally. When her husband, Kwezi, informs Nanta that he is going away on a business trip that will take all weekend, she sees it as an opportunity to spend some time with her family only to find to stumble on Kwezi marrying her much younger sister, Kesa, in a traditional ceremony at Nanta’s family home with everyone in attendance apart from her. Nanta’s sense of betrayal and humiliation by all of those closest to her is complete when Kwezi unremorsefully informs that Kesa is pregnant with his baby. When Nanta has a very public meltdown at her parent’s home and proceeds to disrupt the ceremony, she is angrily and forcibly dragged out of the family compound by her father and is informed that she should be grateful that it was her sister that Kwezi was marrying because then they would not lose their generous benefactor. Further isolated from friends and family, due to the embarrassment of in having the incident broadcast widely circulated on social media, Nanta is forced to make a decision about who she

programme.title: The Pretty Ones Are The Loneliest
programme.desc: Emem is a 37-year old woman in a rocky marriage not helped by the fact that her teenage son from a previous relationship, Bassey, always gets in trouble, drawing the angst of his stepfather Tamuno. Emem decides to take him to stay with her Widower Father; Dr. Udoh who had retired and has been living in his country home since the death pf his wife. Bassey who has always searched for a place to belong finds it in his Grandfather's home. They form a bond which transcends that of relatives and he has to help his Grandfather who has a love trouble of his own; He is smitten by a nurse he meets on one of his walks but he has never been with another woman aside his late wife who he had been married to for over 53 years. Emem is still dealing with her crumbling marriage and is tempted when a wild painter she interviews for her magazine falls in love with her. Bassey also somehow gets entangled with an emotionally unavailable girl and all three are trying to overcome their loneliness.

programme.title: Coerced Revenge
programme.desc: A story about a young girl forced to bomb a university by her uncle to save her mother's life.

programme.title: Dara
programme.desc: In Port Harcourt, ambitious university creative Idara, known on campus as Dara, has built a reputation on charisma, talent, and rising social-media fame. His life takes a dangerous turn when he falls for Sophie, a brilliant young woman already desired by Agama, the ruthless leader of a violent campus brotherhood that controls the university through intimidation and force. Daraâ€™s open affection is seen as a direct challenge to Agamaâ€™s authority. What begins as campus rivalry quickly escalates into public humiliation, calculated threats, and brutal assault. Pressured to join rival factions for protection, Dara refuses to surrender his identity or his love. As pride collides with power and loyalty fractures under fear, Dara is pushed toward a breaking point that will change everything.

programme.title: From Kisii with Love
programme.desc: He proposed, but she said no: She never saw him as serious. Heartbroken, he retreated until his mother intervened. Using wisdom and truth, she bridged their emotional gap, helping him understand true commitment and guiding them back together.

programme.title: Siyabonga (We Are Thankful)
programme.desc: Siyabonga (english title: We Are Thankful), named after the films main character Siyabonga Majola, is a docufiction film set in the KwaZulu Natal region of modern day South Africa. It makes use of footage from both the narrative and documentary tradition. In the film we follow Siyabonga, a young man making theatre plays in the township of Mphopomeni. One day he hears the surprising news that a movie is to be made in a nearby town and he makes it his mission to be part of the film. From conspiring with a maid to steal wifi from the umlungus (white people) so he can write an email to the film producers, to rebuffing a friend’s urgent plea for him to improve his luck through witchcraft, Siyabonga's journey takes him down many surprising paths that ultimately lead him to meeting with the film's director. Here we observe the conversation that caused the film we are watching to come into existence. A film based on real events, re-enacted by those who lived through them, we follow this extraordinary man as he does all he can to try and improve his life and take control of his fortune. Siyabonga's past echoes in his present in much the same way that South Africa's own history seems to have left an indelible mark on the people and places of the film. Time moves differently in such spaces. Places are never confined to just the here and now, but rather some kind of eternal memory.

programme.title: The Omusinde
programme.desc: Sebastian going through rough times with his girlfriend Ellie who cheats on him with his friends Tom. Sebastian's dad is sick with stroke in Cologne Hospital and later his dad reveals to him. His mother is still alive and living in Africa, Sebastian cuts short his trip to Paris and goes to Africa to look for his mother without his dad permission after discovering his mother is alive. He falls in trouble by loving a woman of a tough village son of a chief which is prohibited to fall in love for a woman with having performed Imbalu 'circumcision' cultural practiced which is a passage from being a boy to become a man every man who has never done Imbalu still remains a boy who's never given privilege of marrying and decision making. And went against the cultural values when he refused to be circumcised...

programme.title: I Bwiza (Tenacity)
programme.desc: Gatoni Maya, a 23-year-old brave girl, is resolved to fulfill her deceased father's dream of making a living through arts. Together with her co-workers in an artist collective named I Bwiza, she fights the injustice against artists by confronting Myasiro, the owner of the company that sells their arts; all while taking care of her ailing mother’s treatment and her younger brother’s school fees.

programme.title: When Love Happens Again
programme.desc: When an event planner leaves her boyfriend behind for Los Angeles, their relationship is put to the test. Partnered with a billionaire business mogul, she finds herself further from home than ever before. Will love overcome distance?

programme.title: 18 Hours
programme.desc: A rookie paramedic survives 18 hours in an ambulance for the life of a road crash victim who won’t be admitted to any hospital.

programme.title: Across the Rising Sun
programme.desc: “Across the Rising Sun” is a Martial Arts Action/Drama about a rookie Investigator for the Nigerian Police Force named Naji Diallo, who is assigned her first case, the suspected suicide of a foreign English teacher. It’s supposed to be an open and shut case, but when the victim’s brother, a former bounty hunter named Derrick arrives from America, the case begins to unravel. Convinced his sister was murdered and consumed by his lust for justice, Derrick embarks on a mission of revenge that threatens to tear apart the city of Lagos, while during the course of her investigation, Naji stumbles onto the trail of an unknown gun smuggler operating in the area. Naji’s case and Derrick’s lust for revenge come crashing together to reveal a crime of epic proportions and the two of them must team up together to save thousands of innocent lives.

programme.title: Christmas With The King
programme.desc: Queen Atere, of the Zirewan Kingdom, must find her sister before Christmas but it proves to be a difficult task as more problems arise in the kingdom. She has to risk it all to bring family back home in time for Christmas.

programme.title: Going Bongo
programme.desc: Dr. Burger happily lands a job at the prestigious Beverly Hills medical centre in Los Angeles and his eager to impress his new boss. After attending a Gala arranged by his superiors, he “mistakenly” volunteers to go work in Africa for a month at an under resourced hospital. Leaving his fiancé behind, this American Doctor heads out to Tanzania to follow through with his promise.

programme.title: The Thorns
programme.desc: In the romantic dramedy, The Thorns, Lateef Adedimeji as Pelumi, resolves never to love again because of the crisis he encountered with love on different occasions, until he meets the hilarious fake Prophet Egbojuayosoke, Woli Agba Ayo Ajewole, who prophesies that love is about to smile on him again.

programme.title: The Silent Intruder
programme.desc: Catherine seeks help from Zaki, a charismatic but troubled sex therapist, to address her marriage's intimacy issues. As she becomes ensnared in his seductive but dangerous world, she soon realizes Zaki's allure masks a dark, compulsive nature. Her attempt to escape not only exposes Zaki's psychopathy but also ignites his obsession, transforming her effort to salvage her marriage into a desperate struggle to survive his increasingly menacing advances. The story encapsulates the peril of mistaking manipulation for affection and the resilience needed to break free from a predator's clutches.

programme.title: Aisha
programme.desc: Aisha, a young ambitious business woman living in the city returns to her home village to attend her younger sister’s wedding. As she re-connects with her past, meeting family and friends, something unexpected happens that has disastrous consequences for her life. Everyone else would rather turn a blind eye, but Aisha decides to fight a tough battle for justice. This film is dedicated to all women who have gone through the same extraordinary sufferings as Aisha.

programme.title: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Neema, a successful accountant haunted by her past, seeks her missing sister Tabu with relentless determination, guided by a witch doctor. Her journey is fraught with trials—getting lost in a mystical forest, surviving a bus fire, and encountering Sabri, a teacher, and Farida, a bar owner who alternates between ally and adversary. In a remote village, Neema faces moral dilemmas and violent confrontations, uncovering shocking truths about Tabu’s abusive husband Frank. Their reunion is bittersweet as Tabu refuses to leave Frank. After he brutally attacks Tabu, Neema exacts revenge in a deadly showdown, leaving her broken and bleeding on a bridge. Themes of family loyalty, sacrifice, and violence paint a vivid picture of resilience and despair.

programme.title: The Right Path
programme.desc: Madam Reachel's love for her children blinder her, whenever her husband Mr. Steven tried correcting their mistakes , she would get upset. Tragedy came in when they attended a friend's daughter's birthday party, Reachel got to realize that her children's behaviours were not good and that she had to take immediate action on them, not knowing that it will take away the family's happiness.

programme.title: Tour du Faso
programme.desc: It’s Culture Clash in a sporty way! 1987 the Tour du Faso first took place in Burkina Faso. Up until now it is Africa’s biggest cycling race. Within ten stages, cyclists from Africa and Europa are crossing the sandy desert in an existing race. Amid the clash of European perfectionism and African realities we follow European hobby adventurers and African local heroes in their passionate fight for making their dreams come true. Yet, our film does not focus on the question of who will win – instead, it pays particular attention on the value of the protagonists’ experiences. The race has still retained its original and very African character as a “flawed” – but much more sympathetic – copy of the Tour de France, its European model. Some parts of the course are mere sand tracks, the advertising “caravan” consists of a single car and the cyclists are camping in the savanna during the race. TOUR DU FASO takes the audience on a time travel back to pre-commercialised decades. Following the Tour du Faso, we will get to know more about cycling, Africa and the extraordinary fighting spirit of the underdogs. Here it is still the taking part that counts...

programme.title: Songs About My Mother
programme.desc: The story explores how this toxic dynamic has profoundly shaped the protagonist’s artistic voice, influencing both the themes and emotional intensity of her music. As past wounds resurface and unresolved tensions escalate, the film examines the fragile boundaries between creative inspiration and personal trauma.

programme.title: Mirage
programme.desc: While serving a 5-year sentence at one of Zimbabwe's tightest prisons just outside of Harare, Tambu learns of the abuse of her daughter by her own brother back home. Fuelled by the passionate anger of a single mother, Tambu convinces fellow inmates Memo and Zoe to escape together with her. The plan hangs on a thin thread, as rumours of the escape surface, fuelling an ongoing power struggle between one of the officers and the prison warden. Tambu seizes the moment during a prison ceremony by a popular pastor, and on the backdrop of the Zimbabwean coup in 2017, where president Robert Mugabe was ousted. The trio embark on a thrilling and dangerous prison break. As we follow the 3 young women's journey to freedom, we ask ourselves: How do you escape yourself?

programme.title: Thandi
programme.desc: A girl falls in love with a married man she gets pregnant and she gets dumped. She then decides to leave her young baby near a clinic. Sibiya adopts the child, later on Mr. Sibiya falls in love with the biological mother of the child without knowing. After Mr. Sibaya passes away, Connie decides to make the child a prostitute without knowing its the child she dumped years ago.

programme.title: Moms at War
programme.desc: Moms at War is about two mothers who live in the same neighborhood, but hate each other. One felt that the other was a village girl who just got into money and is not fit to be in society with them. But both their kids coincidentally attend the same school and there was a competition that was done for the kids, and both were the top of their class. It comes down to one of them winning the competition and the mothers just go crazy, doing all sort of antics. It's a story of friendship, sisterhood, and bonding in spite of everything.

programme.title: Once Upon a Family
programme.desc: Every family has its issues, and this one is no exception. Once Upon A Family tells the story of a complicated Ghanaian family and the dark secrets they wished to hide - but all comes to light during the family reunion of a lifetime.

programme.title: Liwong
programme.desc: This movie captures a Fondom that refuses to acknowledge a governmental decree, legalising blood and organ donation due to some passed religious belief of the Fon until the Prince gets involved in an auto crash which damages his kidneys and requires transfer. The Fondom is torn apart as some elders want an amendment of the culture while others stick to the old ways for their selfish reasons. The Fon chooses to go the extra mile of saving his son which costs him his life. The struggle of inheritance becomes the next big worry while the prince continues working extremely hard in bringing health to his people while secrets unfold

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S03 E08
programme.desc: After failing to capture the ruthless murderer Augustine Chacon on U.S. soil, Arizona Ranger Burton Mossman relinquishes his badge to cross the border. In Mexico, he goes undercover as a horse thief to join Chacon's gang and spring his trap.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S03 E09
programme.desc: When a bloodthirsty mob storms a jailhouse holding a man accused of attempted murder, they are confronted by a 22-year-old missionary from the Sisters of Charity. Only Sister Blandina can stop the vigilantes from taking the law into their own hands.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - S01 E07
programme.desc: When former slave Jim Beckwourth heads west to seek work as a trapper, he begins what will become one of the most eventful, heroic lives of all the mountain men. As a joke, one of Beckwourth's fellow trappers tells a group of Crow warriors that Beckwourth is a long-lost member of their tribe, and the adventure begins. Adopted by the Crow, Beckwourth joins them in a series of ferocious battles with other tribes, becomes a war chief, and falls in love with a fierce female warrior named Pine Leaf. He then uses his hard-won influence with the Crow to convince them to provide furs to the powerful American Fur Company. But an unexpected visit from legendary trapper and old friend Tom Fitzpatrick sets off a violent collision that forces Beckwourth to choose between the two worlds he loves.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - S05 E08
programme.desc: The cowboys step a little outside of their comfort zones. Looking to offload their new herd, the guys head down to the local stockyard to hone their bartering skills. Cody bounces a crazy rodeo idea off the boys - then uses them guinea pigs. Bubba plans a short getaway with Kaley, but there's a big catch: Booger's been tapped as the babysitter, with Jaclyn lending a helping hand. Kaley wonders if Booger is up to the challenge. His first attempts to feed and dress little Andie suggest he most certainly is not! While Bubba and Kaley aren't sure they'll return home to find everything in one piece, they do get some great news from houseguest Andrew. Cody is desperate to find the final missing piece for his rodeo: an announcer. While Booger adamant that he's the perfect man for the job, Cody has to resort to using reverse psychology on his old friend to avoid disaster.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E18
programme.desc: Jack Vandergelt III is a millionaire set on courting a woman who despises rich men. Bret Maverick agrees to switch identities with Vandergelt so he can be loved as a humble man, but his father arrives to complicate matters.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S05 E08
programme.desc: During an arrest, Cheyenne shoots and kills the lawless son of Nathanael Grimm, a wealthy man who controls the town. Cheyenne faces a murder charge, and the townspeople are out of work when Grimm closes his mine in revenge.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S05 E09
programme.desc: Cheyenne arrives in Winslow with a letter recommending him for the marshal's job. As he delivers it to the banker the next morning, Elijah McGuire and his men rob the bank, and Cheyenne finds himself caught in the middle.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S04 E04
programme.desc: Two prison wagon drivers stop at the McCain Ranch looking for whiskey. Lucas refuses since they are taking a murderer named Rudy Croft to be hanged in Yuma. Later, Croft escapes and the guards take Lucas as their prisoner.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S04 E05
programme.desc: Mark takes a job on new neighbor Will Temple's ranch but is taken back by Temple's badly scarred face. When a cavalry officer stops by the McCain Ranch looking for a deserter who committed murder, both Mark and Lucas question who Temple really is.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: When a gunslinger with a bad disposition is nursed back to health and desired by a Quaker girl, he finds himself having to choose between his lawless life or the peaceful world of his newfound love.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E36
programme.desc: Coming home from school, Mark stumbles upon a dead man's body. Lucas discovers he was stabbed and the only clue is a belt with the initials R.M. Lucas leaves Mark with Artemus Quarles, a cousin who is visiting. Quarles, however, is not who he seems.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E37
programme.desc: A renegade Apache named Chaqua raids the McCain Ranch and kidnaps Mark. Lucas gathers a group of men to get Mark back, but Chaqua plans to make him an Apache warrior since he lost his own son. Lucas will stop at nothing to get his son back to safety.

programme.desc: Cheyenne and Smitty travel to Mexico to bring a gang of outlaws accused of killing Cheyenne's close friend to justice. However, after they arrive, they discover that the small Mexican town is under the rule of the gang's leader.

programme.desc: Lucas agrees to ride shotgun on a stagecoach carrying $20,000 in gold for North Fork banker John Hamilton after a man fails to show up. When three men rob the stage and take Mark hostage, Lucas must get both the gold and Mark back safely.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S02 E28
programme.desc: A beautiful headstrong young woman named Marge Crandell doesn't like to be told what to do by anyone. Several men vie for her attention and when Lucas finds her dead, one of the men becomes a prime suspect due to a simple clue, a half-smoked cigar.

programme.title: Cavalry Charge
